definitions.explanation: Moving past someone or something ahead, in a race, on the road, or (of trains) when a faster train passes a slower one at a station.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見事|みごと}→見事：03744_migoto⟧な{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: He made a brilliant overtake just before the finish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各駅|かくえき}{停車|ていしゃ}→各駅停車：15471_kakuekiteisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The local train waits at this station for the express to pass it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}え→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧「{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}き」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: In the traffic rules, passing the car in front without changing lanes is called oinuki.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun of ⟦{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}く→追い抜く：14960_oinuku⟧ (to overtake).

WATCH OUT:
Japan's Road Traffic Act separates two kinds of passing. {追|お}い{抜|ぬ}き is passing without changing lanes; ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}し→追い越し：09216_oikoshi⟧ is changing lanes to pass.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追|お}い{抜|ぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to make a move to overtake
- ⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}き: team pursuit (speed skating, cycling)
